inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: B0015, B0032, B0034, and B0104 make the nearest-work comparison and novelty allocation explicit; any unsupported broad novelty wording is narrowed, and the full flow remains unassigned with the proxy exploratory.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript explicitly compares the work with verified nearest congruence-filtration, trace-identity, or first-jet antecedents and separately allocates what is established, synthesized, or claimed as new for the elementary congruence identity, first-jet laws, finite certificate, and negative-specificity interpretation. Any component lacking verified priority support is framed without a broad novelty claim, while the full Bianchi flow remains unassigned and the proxy remains exploratory.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript adds a genuine nearest-work comparison or narrows some priority language, but leaves at least one of the identity, jet laws, certificate, or negative interpretation without an explicit evidence-backed novelty allocation, or carries the allocation inconsistently across the named framing surfaces, while retaining the full-flow and exploratory-proxy boundaries.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the manuscript more broadly claims priority or significance without a verified comparison, presents the tested candidate or an elementary component as independently novel without support, assigns the full Bianchi flow, or promotes the exploratory proxy beyond its inherited boundary.

items.expected_change_surface: Expected at Round-1 blocks B0015, B0032, B0034, and B0104 across the Introduction, Related work, Position of the present result, theorem framing, and Conclusion.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: B0004 and B0006 visibly distinguish the universal algebraic theorem from finite-panel separation and retain the full Bianchi flow as unassigned.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The title and abstract-facing scope language visibly distinguish the ring-general universal algebraic theorem from separation tested only on a finite marked-word panel, and they do not imply a complete primitive-flow census or assignment of the full Bianchi flow.

items.expected_change_surface: Expected at Round-1 blocks B0004 and B0006, principally the title and matching Abstract scope signal.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: B0056, B0065, B0067, B0068, B0075, and B0084 distinguish pooled and loxodromic-only populations; no primitive-owner collision is asserted without an explicit equivalence and primitivity certificate.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript separately labels the pooled implementation-panel population and the loxodromic-only population and reports the relevant exact collision statistics for each. Every inference is confined to matrix compression unless a distinct primitive loxodromic owner collision is accompanied by explicit owner-equivalence and primitivity evidence; no pooled, parabolic, or identity collision is presented as such an owner witness.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript genuinely separates the populations, supplies some loxodromic-only statistics, or confines some matrix-to-owner language, but leaves a named collision surface pooled or ambiguously labeled, omits a material exact statistic, or presents a candidate owner witness without the complete equivalence and primitivity certificate.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the manuscript further conflates pooled and loxodromic-only populations, strengthens a matrix-compression result into a primitive-owner separation claim, or asserts a primitive loxodromic owner collision without explicit equivalence and primitivity evidence.

items.expected_change_surface: Expected at Round-1 blocks B0056, B0065, B0067, B0068, B0075, and B0084 in Constructive non-injectivity, the Exact finite certificate, and the Route-A interpretation.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: B0072, B0084, B0100, and B0104 state the missing control type and expected pattern as open work and preserve two-of-three coverage, ROUTE_A_EXPLORATORY status, full-flow unassignment, and no Route B.
